name: smartplant
description: SmartPlant — AI + IoT + Maintenance + Operations Platform (production architecture, demo deployment)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.rmSync('frontend/dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('frontend/dist/images',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css'])fs.copyFileSync(p.join('frontend',f),p.join('frontend/dist',f));for(const f of fs.readdirSync('images'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('images',f),p.join('frontend/dist/images',f));console.log('frontend synced to frontend/dist')"
